text:
marta: Heads up — seeing steady mem growth on runtime nodes when we run many long-context sessions. Heap shows lots of ~1-2KB fragments in the KV slab. Suspect slab-robin allocation + prefix canonicalization mismatch is preventing cross-request reuse. Logs + quick heap dump attached.

devon: Can you paste the heap hist / a profiler flame? timeline of growth?

marta: quick heap excerpt: ```
slab: total 24GB used 18.7GB
free-chunks: small 1.3GB (avg 1.6KB)
medium 2.1GB
large 3.4GB
tl;dr lots of small holes``` Also seeing eviction churn at ~35% CPU on bg-evict loop.

akash: If small-chunk fragmentation high, eviction scanning cost spikes. Did we enable slab compaction? Last I checked compaction is off by default because it stalls tails.

devon: Hmm. Two hypotheses: 1) per-session salt makes keys different across requests so identical prefixes don't hit; 2) allocation policy (robin) tries to spread allocations which produces many sub-1KB holes. We saw similar in benchmark when we had short-lived tokens.

noah: @marta do you have example keys? If salt included in key we should canonicalize prefix before generating slab-key. Also maybe add a 'sticky-prefix hint' to route same prefix to same slab pool.

marta: example keys (sanitized): `tenant:abc:session:xxx:prefix:embeddings:v1:nonce:12345` — nonce is appended by runtime for traceability. That defeats prefix caching.

akash: We can change key derivation to drop `nonce` for cache key, while retaining full key in logs. Low-risk patch: `cache_key = sha256(prefix_without_nonce + model + quant)`

devon: Also propose a background compaction job that merges adjacent small free blocks every X cycles. Pseudo: ```for slab in slabs:
  if fragmentation_ratio(slab) > 0.2:
    merge_adjacent_free(slab)``` Need to check pause impact.

marta: Quick mitigation for canary: 1) canonicalize keys (drop nonce) 2) lower robin spread to favor reuse (config `allocation.robin_spread=0.3`) 3) enable compaction with soft-threshold. Plan to roll to canary group `us-west-2a` for 48h and monitor `kv_hit_rate`, `mem_growth_24h`, `evict_cpu_pct`.

perf-bot: autotag: telemetry graph -> https://telemetry.internal/r/xyz kv_hit_rate dropped from 78%->46% on canary? (auto)

noah: :eyes: that's a big delta, maybe the canonicalization needs to be applied at ingestion path not post-hash.

akash: We should bench three configs: baseline, canonicalize-only, canonicalize+compaction. Can someone create the bench job? If we get >20% hit-rate improvement and mem growth <5% baseline, we ship.

marta: I've opened a short RFC and a PR draft: https://git.internal/r/kv-slab-fix. I'll push the canary patch after lunch. ping if you want to be on call.

devon: :thumbsup: I'll add perf counters for `free_frag_bins` and `compaction_runs` and a flame for bg-evict.

noah: :rocket:
